benchmark.dedupe_requirement: Exclude every previously collected ID and any suspected same asset across sources, dates or address aliases; independent evidence review required.
benchmark.timestamp_requirement: First observed after protocol freeze. An update/display date alone does not prove initial publication or a future-time listing.
benchmark.label_requirement: Independently verify source identity, sale, ordinary asset type, total asking price, area, Da Nang geography and evidence hash before revealing predictions.
benchmark.selection: Consecutive independently reviewed new assets by category, never by model residual.

eligibility.geography: Old or expanded Da Nang with explicit address evidence.
eligibility.transaction: Sale of an ordinary single house, land parcel or apartment, not rent or whole commercial buildings.
eligibility.currency: VND; price_million is total asking price in million VND, not per-m2, a deposit, installment or a starting range.
eligibility.numeric: Price and area must be finite and positive, verified independently from the main source listing.
eligibility.date: Record actual first observation with timezone after freeze; preserve displayed date and its semantics separately.
eligibility.uniqueness: No previously collected source ID or suspected physical-asset overlap; documented independent dedupe review.
eligibility.sampling: First 50 qualifying, independently reviewed assets per category in observation order; log all excluded/rejected records and reasons.
eligibility.out_of_train_range: Retain valid ordinary assets outside the observed train range and report them separately; do not suppress extremes to improve scores.

benchmark.scoring_rule: Keep models, encoders and selection fixed; report all collected/rejected/verified counts and per-category errors; do not use benchmark to tune.

integrity: Frozen dataset/model outputs and analysis inputs verified by SHA256; other prior artifacts compared by size/mtime/ctime before and after this read-only analysis.

policy.label_action: Diagnostic flags only; no automatic relabeling, deletion or retraining.
policy.benchmark_selection: Consecutive independently reviewed new assets by category, never by model residual.

limitations: Diagnostic associations do not prove why a model fails.
Validation was used for selection; no new independent performance result.
Tail prices/large residuals do not prove incorrect source labels.
Cache coverage is only this source-review round, not all historical verifications.
Header agreement is not independent confirmation of total market/transaction value.
The benchmark pilot target is a workload proposal, not an accuracy guarantee.
